Title: Kirtiraja Prabhu Acting GBC

Full_Text: That Naveen Krsna Prabhu be recommended to the North American GBC to be a permanent member of that committee as North American Minister of Finance.
Title: NA Minister of Finance Recommendation

Full_Text: That Badrinarayan Prabhu be admitted as an assistant GBC for southern California.
Title: Assistant GBC Southern California

Full_Text: That Jayapataka Swami be excused for 1/2 hour from being penalized for late attendance at all meetings in Mayapur. (Rule of Order)
Title: Attendance Penalty Exemption

Full_Text: Whereas, the GBC body has heard that Vasudeva Prabhu is considering submitting his resignation from the GBC body, it is resolved that Vasudeva Prabhu be encouraged to remain as GBC of Fiji at least until he completes the development of the temple project in Suva.
Title: Encouragement to Vasudeva Prabhu

Full_Text: The GBC requests Vicitravirya Prabhu to take up the part-time service of Executive Secretary of the Ministry of Justice. The GBC greatly appreciates the high quality of service he has already rendered for the Ministry and looks forward to his valuable contribution in the future.
Title: Justice Ministry Executive Secretary

Full_Text: The GBC asks Abhiram Prabhu to take up service in Southern Florida as Regional Secretary under the GBC, Tamal Krsna Goswami. The GBC greatly appreciates his willingness to perform this service, looks forward to working closely with him and would like the pleasure of his association at all North American GBC committee meetings and at the annual GBC meeting at Mayapur.
Title: South Florida Regional Secretary

Full_Text: Anyone holding ISKCON's assets in his private name, in the name of another, or in the name of a corporate entity and controlled by himself or another shall provide an annual detailed confidential declaration of such assets and the reasons for the holding arrangements to his GBC representative. When the GBC representative holds such assets, he shall disclose the same information to the GBC body in the manner provided by it.
Title: Declaration of Private Asset Holding

Full_Text: For any devotee connected with any ISKCON temple in North America to collect for the Hare Krsna Food for Life program, an "ISKCON Food for Life" program, or any other ongoing Hare Krsna free food-to-the-needy distribution program, the local temple president must first contact the North American Hare Krsna Food for life committee to obtain permission and establish conditions under which those devotees may collect for this free prasadam distribution program.
Title: Food for Life Collection NA

Full_Text: If it becomes known that anyone living outside a North American ISKCON temple is collecting in the name of the Hare Krsna Food for Life program... it is the duty of the local temple president and the local GBC representative to report this immediately... It will then become the duty of the local temple authorities and the GBC representative for the area to stop this illegal representation... If the committee then determines that the temple president and/or local GBC representative for the area must utilize criminal prosecution to stop the illegal collector, he/they must do so.
Title: Stopping Illegal Food for Life Collection

Full_Text: No ISKCON member, including GBC members, may make public statements on ISKCON's position or policy on major issues affecting ISKCON's image or policies across an entire nation or groups of nations, unless such a policy or position has already been established and is available in written form or unless the devotee wishing to make such a statement does so with permission from either the GBC executive officers or the Minister of Public Affairs. Further, neither the Minister of Public Affairs nor the GBC executive officers may grant such permission without consulting first with one another.
Title: Restriction on Public Statements

Full_Text: That Hrdayananda das Goswami shall deliver the master copy of the report cards prepared by the 50-man committee convened in 1987 to the Corresponding Secretary. They shall be kept strictly confidential and be brought to Mayapur 1989 for dispensation.
Title: Report Card Master Copies Delivery

Full_Text: That the North American Hare Krsna Food for Life Committee consist of Mukunda Goswami, Balavanta das, Rupa Monohar and Adi Raja das.
Title: NA Food for Life Committee Composition

Full_Text: In the event that the Belgian bank or other creditors force the sale of New Mayapur, the GBC reluctantly approves the moving of the New Mayapur Deities to a more suitable location.
Title: New Mayapur Deity Relocation

Full_Text: That the GBC gives Agrani Maharaja permission to approach the GBC body by correspondence proposal to move the Deities installed in Berbice, Guyana, to a more suitable location.
Title: Berbice Guyana Deity Move

Full_Text: That a committee consisting of Guru Gauranga das, Tosan Krsna das and Gopal Krsna Goswami be formed to recommend to the GBC guidelines for the proper functioning of the Executive Committee.
Title: EC Functioning Guidelines Committee

Full_Text: That the various issues regarding Mayapur be referred to the Indian GBC sub-committee for consideration.
Title: Mayapur Issues Sub-committee Referral

Full_Text: That the GBC hereby creates the post of "Global Minister of Sannyasa Services." The minister shall be a male ISKCON male member appointed by the GBC for renewable terms of one year. The duties of the Minister should be as follows: i) To help ISKCON sannyasis... ii) To help... maintain... the sanctity of the sannyasa order. iii) To help... make sure the sannyasis in ISKCON keep a high standard... v) To help the GBC deal with rumors or complaints... vii) To help the GBC make decisions about sannyasa and sannyasis from time to time.
Title: Global Minister of Sannyasa Services Created

Full_Text: That Jayadvaita Swami be appointed ISKCON Global Minister of sannyasis.
Title: Global Minister of Sannyasis Appointment

Full_Text: That the press release issued in April 1987 by the GBC has always been and remains the authorized GBC position on Kirtanananda Swami.
Title: Kirtanananda Position Reaffirmed

Full_Text: That New Vrndavan and its satellite temples and centers in Columbus, Cleveland, Akron, Pittsburgh and Morgantown, and any other cities such as Washington, New York and Philadelphia, are not officially associated with ISKCON, as they are not following the GBC directives of 1987 re Kirtanananda Swami. Furthermore, these temples and the devotees there are hereby enjoined from using the name ISKCON, The Hare Krsna movement, International Society for Krsna Consciousness. The devotees at these temples are encouraged to reestablish their connection with ISKCON, for which purpose they may contact the GBC Executive Committee.
Title: Dissociation of New Vrndavan Satellites

Full_Text: That the ISKCON Publication Review Board consists of Ravindra Svarupa das, Hrdayananda das Goswami, Satsvarupa das Goswami, Tamal Krsna Goswami, Jagadish Goswami, Jayadvaita Swami, Garuda das, Gour Govinda Swami, Sadaputa das and Bhakti Caru Swami.
Title: Publication Review Board Members

Full_Text: That Garuda das be appointed Minister of Vaisnava Cultural History. The precise scope and functions of this ministry shall be defined in the course of the coming year and submitted for approval of the GBC, either by correspondence procedure, or at the 1989 general meeting.
Title: Minister of Vaisnava Cultural History

Full_Text: That the GBC body feels that in the case of the sale of the Greater Kailash Temple in Delhi, Gopal Krsna Maharaja did not follow proper procedures; nor did he consult with the GBC sufficiently in his interpretation of Srila Prabhupada's will. However... acting in good faith... We, therefore, give our blessings to this exceptional transaction. Be it known, however, that no precedent has been established by this procedural anomaly and unconfirmed interpretation of Srila Prabhupada's will.
Title: Delhi Temple Sale Transaction

Full_Text: That the Radha Parathasarathi Deities of the Delhi temple maybe moved to the proposed new location only after the Indian GBC sub-committee has inspected the new facilities and given their approval.
Title: Delhi Deity Move Approval

Full_Text: That the current members of the Executors Committee are to be as follows: Jayapataka Swami, Gopal Krsna Goswami, Giriraja Swami, Guru Gauranga das, Lokasaksi das, Toshan Krsna das, Naresvara das and Kirtiraja das.
Title: Executors Committee Membership

Full_Text: That Guru Gauranga prabhu be appointed as chairman of the Executors Committee.
Title: Executors Committee Chairman Appointment

Full_Text: That the GBC accepts the Yoga Pitha Gaudiya Panjika calendar as authoritative for ISKCON on the instructions of Srila Prabhupada. It is also Srila Prabhupada's instructions that the Panjika be followed in any time zone of the world according to the same Calendar date as observed in Mayapur. Bhakti Caru Swami shall secure and certify an official translation. [Provisional Order]
Title: Yoga Pitha Gaudiya Panjika Adoption

Full_Text: That the Bhaktivedanta Swami Charity Trust is recommended to replace Bhavananda das with Sivarama Swami as a trustee.
Title: Bhaktivedanta Swami Charity Trust Trustee

Full_Text: That the following Provisional Orders be retired: 1987 #24, 30, 34, 40, 42, 50, 74, 92 1986#6, 8, 16, 38, 60, 65
Title: Retirement of Provisional Orders

Full_Text: That Jayapataka Swami spend seven months of the next year in Bengal and Assam, and he should not travel outside his own GBC zone of responsibility.
Title: Jayapataka Swami Travel Restriction

Full_Text: In pursuance of Resolution #79, the GBC requests Brahmatirtha das to enthusiastically take on the responsibility of overseeing the successful collection of funds from all the temples in North America.
Title: NA Samadhi Fund Oversight

Full_Text: That temple presidents are recommended to encourage some devotees in their temples to participate in the upcoming KumbhaMela festival in January, 1989. The 100th anniversary of Srila Prabhupada in 1996 should be publicized during this festival.
Title: KumbhaMela Festival 1989

Full_Text: That rules of order #50 from the 1986 GBC meeting be superceded to read as follows: Those eligible to attend and vote... 1) The president of any authorized temple... listed in BTG... 2) Regional secretaries. 3) ...guests may be invited... 4) Head-masters of Gurukulas with more than 50 students, and non-GBC global ministers.
Title: Managers Meeting Eligibility Revision

Full_Text: Since the BBT meeting on July 15 & 16, 1987 in Stockholm had an ambiguous and undefinitive outcome, the GBC wishes the BBT to reconstitute itself... Accordingly, the GBC asks that Jayapataka Swami, Hrdayananda das Goswami and Tamal Krsna Goswami to submit their resignations as International Trustees. However, before any resignations are accepted, the current trustees elect replacements and additions up to a total of seven, and place these names before the GBC for its blessings.
Title: International BBT Reconstitution

Full_Text: That the GBC direct its members, Indian and all other BBT trustees and management to follow the directives of the International BBT trustees regarding matters of International BBT concerns, such as the securing of copyrights to Srila Prabhupada's books.
Title: Directive on International BBT Concerns

Full_Text: That the GBC gives its blessings to the plan conceived of by the current International BBT trustees to replace the three resigning trustees with Sesa das, Isvara Swami and Naresvara das under the condition that when they decide to add two additional trustees they again seek the blessings of the GBC body at the annual meeting for these additional names.
Title: New BBT Trustees Approval

Full_Text: That the four devotees present who were part of the former International BBT (Tamal Krsna Goswami, Gopal Krsna Goswami, Jayapataka Swami and Hrdayananda das Goswami) shall be requested to recommend an additional two persons to be part of the newly constituted International BBT. This resolution modifies Resolution #43 above.
Title: Additional Int'l BBT Recommendations

Full_Text: That the local BBT's are requested to withhold transfer of copyrights to an International BBT, as under resolution #40 above, until a proper constitution and by-laws have been accepted by the GBC. The GBC Body appoints a committee of Gopal Krsna Goswami, Jayadwaita Swami, Hari Vilas, Sesa, Bhima and Sri Rama to study the issues involved and recommend a constitution and by-laws to the GBC body through correspondence vote.
Title: Withholding Copyright Transfers

Full_Text: That the GBC Body gives its blessings to Jayadwaita Swami and Hari Vilas das to be added to the International BBT Trustees, as per the recommendation of the four-man committee mentioned in Resolution #72 above.
Title: Jayadvaita Swami and Hari Vilas Int'l BBT Trustees

Full_Text: That it is recommended that all ISKCON members should, as much as possible, distribute Prabhupada's books and particularly to participate in the Srila Prabhupada Marathon. A proper standard would be to go on book distribution at least once a week.
Title: Prabhupada Marathon and Book Distribution

Full_Text: That resolution #73 from the 1988 GBC meeting is repealed and is replaced with the following: That the local BBT's are requested to withhold transfers of copyrights as under resolution #40 above, until a proper constitution and by-laws have been accepted by the Executive Committee on behalf of the GBC.
Title: Copyright Transfer Repeal and Replacement

Full_Text: That the GBC accepts the resignation of Jagadish Goswami as Minister of Education. The Ministry of Education is herewith dissolved and replaced by the ISKCON Board of Education. The ISKCON Board of Education is a GBC standing committee dealing with primary and secondary education in ISKCON, composed of GBC and non-GBC members. ...It shall, in addition, establish and maintain a cultural administrative office.
Title: Dissolution of Education Ministry

Full_Text: The members of the ISKCON Board of Education are: Tosan Krsna das, Chairman; Jagadish Goswami, Sivarama Swami, Bhaktisvarupa Damodara Swami, Ravindra Swarup das, Bhurijana das, Vrikodara das, Kirtiraj das, Sri Rama das, Dhanvantari Swami, Vrisha das.
Title: Board of Education Members

Full_Text: Each GBC Zonal Secretary shall collect an educational tax of $200 from the grhasthas in his zone, and remit to the Board of Education, by June 1, 1988.
Title: Educational Tax collection

Full_Text: The GBC body approves the proposal for a full and final settlement of the M.M. De case for a maximum amount of 6 lakhs. The part of that amount that should have been paid to the son and daughter will be paid by the M.V.T. (approximately Rs. 3.5 lakhs.) according to Srila Prabhupada's will.
Title: Settlement of M.M. De Case

Full_Text: That all temples and Trusts that had been put into jeopardy by the M.M. De case be responsible for raising the balance amount to repay the M.V.T. for the advanced amount.
Title: Repayment Responsibility for M.M. De Case

Full_Text: The GBC sanctions the removal of the Deities from the Mexico city farm to Guadalajara and the selling of the farm, with the provision that the money be used for the purchase of the Mexico City temple.
Title: Mexico City Farm Sale

Full_Text: That the 1988 GBC Executive Budget Assessment shall be $100 per member.
Title: GBC Executive Budget 1988

Full_Text: Whereas, beyond the funds already in hand, the Vrindaban Samadhi Construction Fund requires Rs. 35 Lakh, and to guarantee the Vrindaban Samadhi's timely completion, the GBC resolves that the 1987 GBC resolution requiring various temples to provide specified funds to the Vrindaban Samadhi Construction Fund be reaffirmed as the principal fund raising method and be continued.
Title: Vrindaban Samadhi Fund Reaffirmation

Full_Text: All temples in default... are directed to immediately remit the balance. ...However, if from March 1, 1988 to July 1, 1988, less than Rs. 16 Lakh has been received... the difference is to be immediately loaned... by either the International BBT Mayapur Land Purchase Fund, or... from the Mayapur Samadhi Construction Fund. ...This same procedure is to be repeated for an additional Rs. 16 Lakh, to be received no later than December 1, 1988.
Title: Vrindaban Samadhi Loan Provisions

Full_Text: That the March, 1987 resolutions # 86, section D, pertaining to Guru removal, be modified to read: "Removal. If the Guru becomes openly inimical to Srila Prabhupada or ISKCON, or otherwise acts demoniacally; or becomes an impersonalist (mayavadi) or who preaches the philosophy of unauthorized or asampradaya against Lord Caitanya Mahaprabhu's principles: or blatently and consistently defies ISKCON and GBC policies: or when one's attachment to sense gratification is serious, prolonged or hopeless, as per sastric injunctions, he shall be removed from his position as initiating guru."
Title: Amendment of Guru Removal Law

Full_Text: The suspension of Bhagavan das, Bhavananda das, and Ramesvara das as ISKCON Gurus be continued.
Title: Continuation of Guru Suspensions

Full_Text: That the following devotees are appointed to research on the basis of guru, sadhu and sastra unresolved questions concerning the Guru: Jayadvaita Swami, Bhaktividya Purna Swami, Atmatattva das, Virabahu das, Gour Govinda Swami, Bhakti Caru Swami, Gopiparanadhana das, and the Minister of Vaisnava Cultural History. Bhakti Caru Swami is appointed to coordinate the research work.
Title: Guru Issues Research Committee

Full_Text: That there is a moratorium on all "pre-initiation" or preliminary initiation ceremonies until the GBC decides by vote on the legitimacy of such procedures. This may be conducted by Correspondence Resolution.
Title: Moratorium on Pre-initiation Ceremonies

Full_Text: That the GBC shall prepare a position paper explaining 1987 resolution #66-68 concerning re-initiation. Devotees who are in doubt about re-initiation should wait until they have read this paper. The paper shall be prepared by Bhakti Caru Maharaj and the research committee by Mayapur, 1989.
Title: Re-initiation Position Paper

Full_Text: That Gaur Kesava das be officially added to the researchers on Guru Issues.
Title: Guru Issue Researcher Addition

Full_Text: That the relevant section of the GBC Rules of Order dealing with the duties of the GBC secretary be amended to read as follows: "He shall summon and attend all meetings of the GBC and shall be responsible that the minutes thereof are recorded in the minutes book under himself and the Chairman of the meeting, and thereafter the GBC members present may sign."
Title: Amendment of Secretary Duties

Full_Text: When a person becomes a member of ISKCON or assumes an office within ISKCON, he does so on the condition of submission to the ecclesiastical jurisdiction of ISKCON; and however much he may dissatisfied with the exercise of that jurisdiction, he shall refrain from invoking the supervisory power of the civil court but shall seek redress of any grievance(s) through the ISKCON judicial process. Otherwise, he may be removed from office and or his membership in ISKCON terminated.
Title: Ecclesiastical Jurisdiction Condition

Full_Text: That, should the local GBC for an ISKCON building with installed Deities propose to sell such property, and/or move the Deities, he must first approach the Executive Committee, who shall appoint a 3-man committee to investigate the situation... If the 3-man committee finds that the proposal is acceptable, then the entire GBC body may be approached... If the 3-man committee recommends against the sale... Executive Committee shall be empowered to take whatever steps are necessary... including appointing an ad-hoc co-GBC. [Provisional Order]
Title: Property Sale and Deity Removal Protocol

Full_Text: That an ISKCON Publication Review Board be established to review books and publications, and publish statements concerning the value of the books and publications for ISKCON devotees, especially with reference to their conformity to the teachings of Srila Prabhupada.
Title: Publication Review Board Created

Full_Text: LEAVE OF ABSENCE A GBC may be granted a leave of absence only at his own request... a. acute and unremitting health problem(s); b. compelling personal reasons;... If granted, the leave of absence shall not exceed a period of one year at a time. A majority vote, quorum being present, is required... Although a member may be eligible for a leave of absence, it shall not make redundant or inhibit a motion to censure, suspend or remove.
Title: GBC Leave of Absence Rules

Full_Text: A GBC member may tender his resignation at any time. However, it must be tendered in writing to be valid. A resignation tendered during the year shall be accepted by the GBC Executive Committee on a provisional basis... A member whose letter of resignation has been received by the Executive Committee may not subsequently withdraw it... A resignation which is voted accepted takes effect immediately, unless it is otherwise provided at the time.
Title: GBC Resignation Procedures

Full_Text: CENSURE A GBC member may be censured for... I. Misconduct and indiscipline... b. Vilification of ISKCON... g. Unexcused absence... i. Failure to complete prescribed committee assignments... II. Improper discharge of duty... III. Spiritual discrepancy... failure to follow strictly the rules... Neglect of adequate Krsna Conscious measures to stem notoriety for deficient japa. ...A member who has been censured three times shall be placed on probation.
Title: GBC Censure Protocols

Full_Text: A member censured three times shall be placed on probation... specific program of rectification for the period... Measures may include: Assignment to Padayatra, Prabhupada Samadhi or Dhama seva, Curtailment of speaking and/or voting privilege... The period of probation shall not exceed one year.
Title: GBC Probation Procedures

Full_Text: The Body may suspend a member when there is sufficient reason to believe that: a. continuation of his status... is injurious to ISKCON... b. he has committed any noxious or reprehensible acts. ...A majority vote of the GBC Body... shall be required... Terms: He may not attend GBC meetings... He may not vote... He may not exercise GBC functions of any kind. ...A subcommittee [shall] carefully monitor the progress.
Title: GBC Suspension Protocols

Full_Text: A member shall be removed from the GBC Body for... a. Violation of any of the four regulative principles b. Persistent neglect to complete 16 rounds of japa daily. ...He has been suspended at least two times... He has committed any particularly noxious or reprehensible acts for which rectification is most unlikely. ...A 2/3 vote, quorum being present, is required to adopt a motion to remove.
Title: GBC Removal Protocols

Full_Text: That a grhastha or vanaprastha should not take the sannyasa order, unless: a. the wife is in agreement by writing... b. All of the daughters are married or financially independent... c. The sons are self-supporting... d. He has arranged financial support for the wife... e. He agrees that, in principle, ISKCON is not responsible for such support or arrangements.
Title: Prerequisites for Sannyasa from Grhastha/Vanaprastha

Full_Text: That a brahmacari be considered for sannyasa only if he has actually strictly followed his vows for at least ten years and is at least forty years old. In exceptional cases, a man may be awarded sannyasa before the age of forty by a 2/3 majority vote... To take sannyasa at the age of 50, one must have been on a waiting list for two years; at 45, three years; at 40, four years, and at 35, five years.
Title: Brahmacari Sannyasa Prerequisites

Full_Text: That a proposal to the GBC Body shall be considered as a "Correspondence Proposal" if it meets one of the following requirements: 1. duly submitted before... 2. presented at annual meeting... 3. recommended in writing to the EC by any three GBC men. ...The Executive Committee shall take whatever steps... After 60 days... send for a vote... Sixty days shall be allowed for return of ballots. ...If proposal requires majority... 2/3 return required... If proposal requires 2/3... 80% return required.
Title: Correspondence Proposal Rules

Full_Text: That it is recommended that traveling preachers be sensitive to the concerns of the local authorities in a zone or a temple, and that, as far as possible, they inform the local GBC's and authorities about their schedule before their arrivals in a zone or temple.
Title: Sensitivity of Traveling Preachers

Full_Text: That the rule of order #97 of 1987 be changed from unanimous to two-thirds.
Title: Amendment of 1987 Rule 97

Full_Text: The zonal assignments for 1988-89 are as follows: [Lists exhaustive jurisdictions for Agrani Swami, Badrinarayan das, Balavanta das, Bhakti Bhusana Goswami, Bhakti Caru Swami, etc. through Yasomatinanda das, as transcribed in source text].
Title: Zonal Assignments 1988-89

Full_Text: Ramesvara is removed as member of GBC.
Title: Removal of Ramesvara from GBC

Full_Text: Bhagavan's resignation is accepted by GBC.
Title: Resignation of Bhagavan Accepted

Full_Text: Bhavananda is removed as member of GBC.
Title: Removal of Bhavananda from GBC

Full_Text: Whereas Jagajivana Goswami has decided that he can better serve Srila Prabhupada's movement in a different capacity and has tendered his resignation from GBC body, the GBC accepts his resignation and gives him their blessings for his future preaching career.
Title: Resignation of Jagajivana Goswami

Full_Text: Pancadravida is hereby expelled from ISKCON.
Title: Expulsion of Pancadravida from ISKCON

Full_Text: Sundararupa Swami's request for leave of absence from GBC was rejected by the GBC body. He no longer has a GBC position.
Title: Sundararupa Swami Leave Rejection

Full_Text: Brahmananda is removed from the GBC.
Title: Removal of Brahmananda from GBC

Full_Text: 8. a) Whereas Kirtanananda Swami, by his words and deeds has systematically obscured and minimized His Divine Grace A. C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Srila Prabhupada's pre-eminent position as the Founder-Acarya of ISKCON; b) Whereas Kirtanananda Swami in word and deed rejects the Governing Body Commission as the ultimate managing authority in ISKCON, and by so doing is dismantling Srila Prabhupada's vision of unity; c) Whereas Kirtanananda Swami is, in defiance of GBC policy and over the GBC's protest, establishing in North America, India, and Malaysia, temples and institutions controlled by himself alone, thus creating a movement separate from ISKCON; d) Whereas in word and deed, Kirtanananda Swami, while acting independently of ISKCON authority, systematically misrepresents ISKCON to the public, the media, and the government, and thereby brings ISKCON into jeopardy; e) Whereas, as indicated by GBC investigations, numerous, serious illegal acts have occured within his jurisdiction; The ISKCON GBC hereby expels Kirtanananda Swami from ISKCON and thereby removes all his rights and responsibilities related to ISKCON. The ISKCON GBC further issues a notice of non-participation forbidding Kirtanananda Swami to participate in the functions of ISKCON.
Title: Expulsion of Kirtanananda Swami

Full_Text: The GBC approves the text of a letter to all ISKCON devotees regarding the resolution No. 8. above.
Title: Letter Regarding Kirtanananda Expulsion

Full_Text: Resolved that the GBC authorize a committee to execute the following mandate: a) To interview the GBC men and others with relevant information, discuss, and then to express a simple majority vote of confidence or no confidence in the 17 existing GBC members; notes on all members will be accompanied by a voting count and a specific written list of points of rectification.
Title: Vote of Confidence Mandate

Full_Text: Resolved that the GBC authorize a committee to execute the following mandate: b) To propose 10 additional candidates for GBC positions in whom the committee feels best exemplify the qualities of GBC members as per Prabhupada's instructions, and in whom the committee has full confidence, to work under as GBC members.
Title: Propose New GBC Candidates

Full_Text: That the committee propose fifteen or more names, amongst whom the GBC may elect ten (10) or more.
Title: GBC Election Pool

Full_Text: The members will be constituted of the committee elected by the five-man North American GBC committee. Other than those present (forty-two), additional will be added by the vote of the assembled body of Godbrothers. The additional eight (8) men elected to the committee are: a) Sri Ram prabhu b) Harivilas prabhu c) Vegavan prabhu d) Vrikodara prabhu e) Vishwambar Goswami f) Somaka Goswami g) Ajamila prabhu h) Abhay Charan Swami
Title: Committee Composition and Elections

Full_Text: That the committee convene immediately and meet for the next two days to make recommendations as to steps for rectification and improvements for each of the GBC members on a case by case basis.
Title: Committee Meeting for Rectification

Full_Text: Satsavarupa Maharaj resignation is accepted effective at the end of the Mayapur meeting 1987.
Title: Satsavarupa Maharaj Resignation

Full_Text: Atreya Rsi will be given an (up to) three-year leave of absence from GBC and Ministry of Finance positions, effective at the end of 1987 meetings when new GBC assignments are completed.
Title: Atreya Rsi Leave of Absence

Full_Text: That Guru Gauranga dasa is approved as an acting GBC member with full voting rights and shall be eligible for confirmation as a full GBC member at the 1988 General Meeting.
Title: Guru Gauranga Dasa Acting GBC

Full_Text: That the present GBC body immediately select five (5) new members.
Title: Selection of Five New Members

Full_Text: Harivilas to travel to Africa to investigate the situation in that continent and report to all GBC in that regard. Harivilas is to attempt to recruit Giriraj Swami to go with him on this trip.
Title: Africa Situation Investigation

Full_Text: The temple President's resolution to have Harivilas Prabhu off the GBC is overruled. Harivilas Prabhu is appointed Secretary.
Title: Overruling Temple Presidents on Harivilas

Full_Text: Any qualified and needed GBC men be appointed this year.
Title: Appointment of Needed GBC Men

Full_Text: The following new GBC men were elected: a) Ravindra Swarup Das b) Ganapati Swami c) Agrani Swami d) Niranjana Swami e) Harivilas Das
Title: Election of Five GBC Members

Full_Text: The following new GBC men were elected: a) Kavicandra Maharaj b) Yasomatinandana prabhu c) Guru Prasad Maharaja d) Bhaktibhusana Maharaj e) Danavir prabhu f) Sivaram Maharaj g) Bhakti Caru Maharaj
Title: Election of Seven GBC Members

Full_Text: The following new GBC men were elected: a) GourGovinda Maharaj b) Vrkodar Prabhu c) Prithu Prabhu
Title: Election of Three GBC Members

Full_Text: That a "GBC Resolutions Revision Committee," consisting of Gurugauranga Prabhu, Kavichandra Swami, Danavir Prabhu, Rabindra Swarupa Prabhu, and Jayapataka Maharaja be formed to propose a revision of the GBC Resolutions (to be adopted by a mail vote before the 1988 General Meeting). (P/O)
Title: GBC Resolutions Revision Committee

Full_Text: That the annual GBC meeting in Mayapur be held before the Gaura Purnima festival so that the temple president's meeting be held just prior to the festival and that the "Vrindaban festival" be held after Gaura Purnima. (P/O)
Title: Mayapur and Vrindaban Festival Schedule

Full_Text: That this year's resolution(s) of the GBC body concerning Kirtanananda Swami be personally notified to him. The executive secretary should draft a letter to be approved by the executive committee (17 voted yes, 4 voted against). (P/O)
Title: Notification to Kirtanananda Swami

Full_Text: That the North American GBC Council and the Indian GBC Council each are authorized to invite Kirtanananda Swami to their next meeting. (P/O)
Title: Kirtanananda Meeting Invitations

Full_Text: That Jayapataka Swami and Nitaichand Swami will call an Istaghosti in Mayapur and explain to the disciples the position of Bhavananda prabhu. (P/O)
Title: Bhavananda Position Explanation

Full_Text: That an Indian General Council of GBC should meet three times a year. (P/O)
Title: Indian General Council Meetings

Full_Text: That on behalf of the GBC body and its members a delegation of GBC men shall go to Srimad B.R. Sridhar Maharaj for the following purposes: a) to offer apologies... b) to humbly request him not to reinitiate or rename... c) to request that he also ask his followers that they preach without aggression toward ISKCON... The delegation of GBC members shall be composed of the following: Hrdayananda Goswami, Bhakti Caru Swami, Gopal Krishna Goswami, Bhakti Swarup Damodar Swami, Tamal Krishna Goswami.
Title: Delegation to B.R. [cite_start]Sridhar Maharaj

Full_Text: That there should be no personal seat for gurus in the temple room other than Prabhupada's Vyasasana. One asana shall be present in the temple room for use as an asana for giving Srimad Bhagavatam class. Grand disciple of Srila Prabhupada can sit on the floor if they consider that it is improper to sit on the same asana used by their diksa guru.
Title: Personal Seat Policy for Gurus

Full_Text: That the only gurupuja inside the temple room will be for Srila Prabhupada.
Title: Guru Puja Restricted to Prabhupada

Full_Text: That the disciples of present gurus may worship their guru outside the temple room.
Title: Worship Outside Temple Room

Full_Text: That the disciple can keep the picture of his guru on the altar while offering arotik. The picture must be substantially smaller than those of the disciplic succession or be placed on a lower level. After the arotik, the picture should be taken away.
Title: Guru Pictures During Arotik

Full_Text: That the book Bhagavatam must be higher than the speaker and the stand should be at least as opulent as the speaker's asana according to Vedic Custom.
Title: Bhagavatam Placement Protocol

Full_Text: That in the temple room kirtan, only the name of Prabhupada and his predecessors can be chanted. The words ISKCON guru vrinda ki jaya is to be used in the prema vani prayers in place of the existing prayers.
Title: Temple Kirtan and Prayers

Full_Text: That there should not be any public worship of a guru who is suspended.
Title: No Public Worship of Suspended Guru

Full_Text: That disciples of a suspended guru while performing arotik to the Deities should offer the various articles through Srila Prabhupada to the disciples succession.
Title: Bhoga Offering for Suspended Guru Disciples

Full_Text: That while offering obeisances in a public place the disciples of a suspended guru should recite Srila Prabhupada's pranama mantra aloud and should chant the mantras to the suspended gurus silently or not at all.
Title: Public Obeisances Protocol

Full_Text: That Mukunda Swami's resignation from the service of GBC corresponding secretary is approved. Danavir Prabhu is approved as the new GBC corresponding secretary.
Title: GBC Corresponding Secretary Change

Full_Text: The GBC Body gives its authorization to move the Pancha Tattva Deities from the Bhaktivedanta Village CA. to a suitable temple (Probably to Hawaii temple).
Title: Pancha Tattva Deities Move

Full_Text: That the GBC Executive secretary will hold in his possession all the report cards on individual members presented by the 50 devotee committee. These report cards will be held with the utmost confidentiality.
Title: Confidentiality of Member Report Cards

Full_Text: That ISKCON devotees should strictly avoid hearing or speaking personal criticism of Srimad B.R. Sridhar Maharaja.
Title: Criticism of Sridhar Maharaj

Full_Text: That to avoid offences to Srila Prabhupada and to avoid offences to his Godbrothers the GBC reminds all ISKCON devotees of Srila Prabhupada's instruction that we should avoid the association of His Godbrothers.
Title: Avoidance of Prabhupada Godbrothers

Full_Text: That Pancadravida Swami may be readmitted as a member of ISKCON at any time at the discretion of the GBC Executive Committee.
Title: Pancadravida Swami Readmission

Full_Text: That disciples of a suspended guru when offering bhoga to the deities in the temple or in any ISKCON establishment, (like restaurants, etc) outside the temple must offer through Srila Prabhupada to the disciplic succession.
Title: Bhoga Offering Protocol

Full_Text: That the resignation of Hari Sauri Prabhu as a member of the GBC Body is approved.
Title: Resignation of Hari Sauri Prabhu

Full_Text: That a committee be formed of three sannyasis in good standing and three householders... to function as an advisory council... They shall take petitions from sannyasis, who are feeling difficulty... empowered to either save the sannyasi or recommend that the sannyasi leave the ashram... The committee shall be composed of: Jagadisha Swami, Jayadvaita Swami, Trivikrama Swami, Ravindrasvarupa prabhu, Balavanta prabhu and Bhakta Rupa prabhu.
Title: Sannyasa Advisory Council

Full_Text: That approval is given for the Deities located at Colo Farm, Sydney, Australia to be temporarily re-located in the North Sydney temple until a permanent location is purchased.
Title: Sydney Deity Relocation

Full_Text: That an explanation of the activity and significance of the 50-man committee shall be written by Jayadvaita Swami for the information of the devotees in general.
Title: 50-man Committee Significance Letter

Full_Text: That as per Ambarisa Prabhu's request, the GBC body gives its unanimous blessings to him to give at least 50% of the proceeds from the sale of the Manhattan property for the establishment of a cultural center in Manhattan, under the direction of the local ISKCON authorities and thereafter that he concentrate his energy on establishing the large cultural project envisioned by Srila Prabhupada for Washington D.C. (P/O)
Title: Manhattan Property Sale Allocation

Full_Text: That every GBC man give $100 to cover the annual GBC executive budget of $3,000. (P/O)
Title: GBC Executive Budget Contribution

Full_Text: 51. A. That both Vrindaban and Mayapur establish local construction committees... B. That all ISKCON temples and farm communities contribute a weekly amount... Small $30, Medium $60, Large $100, Maha large $150... C. Zonal areas will entrust a local trustee representative... D. Lists committee members and trustees for various areas.
Title: Samadhi Construction Management

Full_Text: That ISKCON guru daksine is the property of ISKCON to be used for the benefit of the Krsna Consciousness Movement. Therefore such daksine is to be kept in a special account, preferably an ISKCON account, with at least two signatures. Account records are to be kept. (P/O)
Title: Guru Daksine Status

Full_Text: That upon sale of the property of Bhaktivedanta Village, it is to be understood that the BBT loan for the initial purchase of the property is to be paid back by the zone responsible for the purchase.
Title: Bhaktivedanta Village Loan Repayment

Full_Text: That Harikesa Swami, as a member of the Mayapur Samadhi Committee, shall determine when if excess funds are available from the Vrindavan Samadhi account which could be utilized by the Mayapur Samadhi.
Title: Samadhi Fund Allocation Power

Full_Text: That Bhavananda Prabhu, after hearing from appropriate devotees shall decide, in close consultation with deputed GBC members, his proper engagement in devotional service according to guna and karma. It is the consensus of the GBC body, however, that he will not be properly situated as a sannyasi.
Title: Bhavananda Service Engagement

Full_Text: That Bhavananda Swami's status as an ISKCON guru is suspended.
Title: Bhavananda Guru Status Suspension

Full_Text: That a devotee who has received first initiation from Srila Prabhupada has become Srila Prabhupada's disciple. By accepting second initiation from a Godbrother after Srila Prabhupada's disappearance, the disciple further confirms his relationship with Srila Prabhupada and also becomes a disciple of that initiating Godbrother. The second initiation strengthens, not diminishes, one's standing as Srila Prabhupada's disciple.
Title: Definition of Discipleship Relationships

Full_Text: That Vyasapuja for present gurus should only be observed on one day a year coinciding with the birthday of the guru and this celebration can be held in the temple room.
Title: Vyasapuja Timing for Gurus

Full_Text: That a new devotee who follows the four regulative principles and chants sixteen rounds for the first six months should chant Prabhupada's pranama mantra and worship him as founder acharya of ISKCON and his siksha guru. During the second six month period the disciple may choose his future diksa guru and chant his pranama mantra. After a period of at least one year, the devotees may become eligible to be initiated.
Title: Initiation Waiting Periods

Full_Text: That if a guru is engaged in sense gratification violating either one or more of the regulative principles but there is hope that he can be rectified, then his disciples should allow time for such rectification to take place and they should take shelter of Srila Prabhupad and senior Vaisnavas as siksha gurus.
Title: Rectification of Deviated Gurus

Full_Text: That if a guru has become hopelessly entangled in sense gratification and it has been shown either by observation or from his own admissions that he has been regularly violating the regulative principles of Krishna Consciousness and that there is virtually no hope for his rectification, then the disciple should reject him and may accept re-initiation.
Title: Re-initiation for Hopeless Cases

Full_Text: That if the Spiritual Master takes on demoniac qualities and becomes inimical to ISKCON he should be rejected and the disciple may take re- initiation.
Title: Demoniac Qualities Rejection

Full_Text: That if it is ascertained either by the admission of the guru or through irrefutably reliable witness(es) that the guru was fallen at the time of giving initiation, then the disciple has a legitimate reason to reject him and take re-initiation.
Title: Invalid Initiation at Start

Full_Text: That a devotee may serve as a guru in ISKCON after receiving majority approval by a council consisting of all the GBC members of his zone and at least ten senior devotees in that zone. This group of devotees should apply the criteria for gurus recommended in accordance with Srila Prabhupada's books and by the GBC body in its codes, guidelines andrules.
Title: New Guru Approval Council

Full_Text: (Amended on page 152 by resolution number 18 on April 4 1987) GBC compulsory rules for approval of new gurus a) Must be strictly following the four regulative principle and chanting 16 rounds daily. b) Must have been an initiated disciple for at least ten years. c) Must not have had a falldown within 5 years. d) Must have no record of moral turpitude... e) Must not have allegiance to a spiritual authority outside of ISKCON... f) Must not be lacking in understanding and knowledge of the shastra; g) Must support the GBC system...
Title: Compulsory Guru Rules

Full_Text: Privileges of ISKCON members concerning gurus. a) Privilege to Accept Initiation from Guru of Choice... provided the guru is eligible... b) Privilege to listen to any bona fide ISKCON guru's tapes. c) Privilege of an initiated devotee to serve in ISKCON. d) Privilege of a disciple to glorify his guru.
Title: Member Privileges Concerning Gurus

Full_Text: Code of Conduct for a guru a) Standards of action of guru in a temple... 1. No canvassing... 4. Must cooperate... 10. Should not keep separate accounts... b) Standards for a guru with ISKCON Spiritual Authority... c) Standards for a guru in relation with GBC zonal secretaries... d) Standards for a guru in relation with the GBC body... Must respect GBC as representative of Srila Prabhupada... Must stop initiations if asked to do so.
Title: Guru Code of Conduct

Full_Text: That Prahaladananda Swami is authorized by the GBC Body to initiate disciples.
Title: Prahaladananda Swami Initiation Approval

Full_Text: That the following devotees are authorized by the GBC Body to initiate disciple. Bhakti Caru Swami, Kavicandra Swami, Trivikrama Swami, Prabavishnu Swami, Shivaram Swami.
Title: New Guru Authorization List

Full_Text: The following is the GBC position on guru suspension. a) Warning... b) Probation... c) Suspension... d) Removal... If the guru becomes openly inimical to Srila Prabhupad or ISKCON; or otherwise acts demonically; or becomes an impersonalist... e) Renunciation... f) Permission of disciples to accept re-initiation.
Title: Guru Suspension Policy

Full_Text: That after a guru candidate is approved by a council... his name shall be sent to all GBC members. If three GBC members express serious doubts in writing to the council within three months... the candidates shall not accept the role of initiating guru.
Title: Guru Approval Doubts Procedure

Full_Text: That the following devotees are authorized by the GBC body to initiate disciples: Bhaktibusana Swami, Smita Krsna Swami, Rohini Suta das, Sacinandana das, Krsna Ksetra das, Avinas Candra das, Astaratha das.
Title: Initiation Authorization List 2

Full_Text: That Bhagavan das and Rameswara das are suspended as ISKCON gurus.
Title: Suspension of Bhagavan and Rameswara

Full_Text: Resolved that all Godbrothers may participate in all discussions.
Title: Participation of Godbrothers

Full_Text: Only GBC men may give proposals, amendments, and finally vote on these proposals.
Title: Proposal and Voting Rights

Full_Text: Resolved that the GBC authorize a committee to execute the following mandate: c) To propose specific checks and balances to insure the integrity and purity of the GBC membership.
Title: Checks and Balances Mandate

Full_Text: The committee of Godbrothers should, in the presence of all GBC and guests, evaluate GBC men in terms of their gunas and karma as given by Srila Prabhupada. Special attention to be given to: a) Sadhana b) Character c) Ability to enthuse preaching d) Ability to give and take sadhu sangha e) Vijnana or practical understanding as applicable to management.
Title: Evaluation Criteria for GBC

Full_Text: That each GBC member be evaluated based on qualities mentioned by Srila Prabhupada in his letters and qualities of Vaisnavas as included in Srila Prabhupada's books and letters.
Title: Vaisnava Qualities Evaluation

Full_Text: That the committee first praise the good qualities of each Vaisnava before entering the discussion on weaknesses.
Title: Praise Before Weakness Discussion

Full_Text: That all new GBC members admitted during the 1987 General Meeting shall be acting GBC members with full voting rights for one year. Each new GBC member thus admitted shall be subject to reconsideration by two-thirds vote at the 1988 General Meeting. If the requisite two-thirds favorable vote is received he shall be shall be re-appointed for a further one-year term as acting GBC member with full voting rights and shall be eligible for admission as a full GBC member at the 1989 General Meeting.
Title: Acting GBC Probationary Status

Full_Text: That the GBC rule stating that a sannyasi would hold his danda for ten years is superseded by a quote from CC. Madhya-lila, Ch.5 142-143: "However, when one is elevated to the status of hamsa or paramahamsa, after touring and preaching the bhakti cult, he must give up the sannyasa staff."
Title: Sannyasa Staff Rule Change

Full_Text: Resolved that "when a person becomes a member of ISKCON or assumes an office within ISKCON, he does so upon the condition of submission to the ecclesiastical jurisdiction of ISKCON; and however much he may be dissatisfied with the exercise of that jurisdiction, he shall refrain from invoking the supervisory power of a civil court but shall seek redress of any grievance(s) through the ISKCON judicial process. Otherwise, he may be removed from office and/or his membership in ISKCON terminated," be referred to the Minister of Legal Affairs. (Provisional Order)
Title: Submission to ISKCON Jurisdiction

Full_Text: All resolutions be categorized as a rule of order law, or provisional order at the time of passing. (Rule of Order)
Title: Resolution Categorization

Full_Text: That the amount of time a GBC member arrives late to meetings be calculated and that he be penalized in equal loss of voting rights in increments of three-hour sessions in the following year's annual meeting. (Vote: 12 in favor, 6 against, 3 abstentions). The executive officers will be penalized twice as much as non-executive members. (R/O)
Title: Meeting Tardiness Penalties

Full_Text: That the GBC recommend that Srila Prabhupada be glorified in kirtan only by the words, "Jaya Prabhupada" and not "Jaya Jagat Guru Srila Prabhupada" or "Jaya Gurudeva." (Law of ISKCON)
Title: Standardization of Prabhupada Glorification

Full_Text: That it is preferable that any future change of GBC men in India first be discussed in the Indian General Council of GBC and then their suggestion be presented to the International GBC meeting for a decision. (P/O)
Title: Indian GBC Changes Protocol

Full_Text: That all honorific titles should not be used in the public forum but can be used in communications between disciples and disciples to their guru. Any titles like His Divine Grace should be treated as above.
Title: Restrictions on Honorific Titles

Full_Text: That no one should declare himself or allow himself to be declared an acharya or present acharya for a geographical area or for ISKCON. There should not be any official use of the word acharya.
Title: Prohibition of Word Acharya

Full_Text: That a majority vote shall mean that a motion carries when more than half of the voting members present vote in favour of it. In the event that a majority of members present do not do so, the motion is not lost if there is less than a majority against it... [details on reopening floor and absolute majority].
Title: Definition of Majority Vote

Full_Text: That a two thirds vote shall mean that a motion carries when two thirds of the voting members present vote in favour of it. In the event that two thirds of the voting members present do not do so, the motion is not lost if the vote in favour constitutes both an absolute majority and two thirds of the votes cast.
Title: Definition of Two Thirds Vote

Full_Text: That, in the event of a vacancy on the GBC executive committee, the proper procedure shall be as follows: The vacant post of Chairman shall be assumed by the Vice-Chairman... Secretary shall be filled by the runner-up candidate... there shall be three voting members [officers] of the GBC executive committee as all times.
Title: Executive Committee Vacancy Protocol

Full_Text: That during the upcoming year any proposal shall be considered and brought to vote through the mail only if it fulfils one or more the following requirements... 1. duly submitted before annual meeting... 2. handling as correspondence proposal... 3. unanimously approved by EC as emergency proposal.
Title: Mail Vote Requirements

Full_Text: That no GBC meeting shall exceed the scheduled limits of 9:30 AM to 12:30 PM (morning session) and 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM (afternoon session), unless the members unanimously concur that an emergency exists. In the event of an emergency, the maximum extension per session shall be one hour only.
Title: GBC Session Time Limits

Full_Text: That with Bhaktitirtha Maharaja's approval, the GBC will request Visvambhar Maharaj to preach in French-speaking Africa for the coming year.
Title: French-Speaking Africa Preaching

Full_Text: That Jayapataka Swami will be the sole GBC in Karnatika and Kerala. (P/O)
Title: Jayapataka Swami South India GBC

Full_Text: That Prabhavisnu Swami and Jayapataka Swami will be Co-GBCs in Tamil Nadu. (P/O)
Title: Tamil Nadu Co-GBCs

Full_Text: Zonal Assignments: [Lists 30 GBC members from Agrani Swami to Yasomatinandana prabhu with their specific global jurisdictions and Co-GBC relationships as transcribed in the source text].
Title: Zonal Assignments 1987

Full_Text: That Sivaram Swami should be the sole GBC member for England, Scotland, Wales, and Channel Islands. Bhakti Caru Swami is assigned to preach in England.
Title: UK GBC and Preaching

Full_Text: That Mukunda Goswami shall be the GBC member for the ILMT.
Title: GBC for ILMT

Full_Text: That Jagadisa Goswami is approved as Co-GBC of Spain.
Title: Jagadisa Goswami Co-GBC Spain

Full_Text: Election of officers - The GBC executive committee for 1986 is: Chairman - Srila Tamal Krsna Goswami Vice Chairman - Sriman Balavanta Das Adhikary Secretary - Bhagavan Das Goswami
Title: Election of GBC Officers 1986

Full_Text: New GBC members added to the body 1. Prabhavisnu Maharaj as a full voting member
Title: Prabhavisnu Maharaj Voting Member

Full_Text: New GBC members added to the body 2. Sundararupa Maharaj as an acting GBC.
Title: Sundararupa Maharaj Acting GBC

Full_Text: That Guru Gauranga Das will be Minister of Justice and assistant (BG) GBC.
Title: Minister of Justice Appointment

Full_Text: The Privilege Committee will now be known as the GBC Judicial Committee.
Title: GBC Judicial Committee Renaming

Full_Text: The GBC Judicial Committee will be constituted of the following 1. Rupanuga 2. Balavant 3. Prabhavisnu Maharaj 4. Tamal Krsna Maharaj 5. Jagadisha Maharaj
Title: Judicial Committee Composition

Full_Text: The GBC Body considers that the meeting held at New Vrndavan in September 1985 was not properly called and held according to the existing rules and proceedures (void Resolution of March 31 pg 64 April 1 Bdg.
Title: Invalidation of Sept 1985 Meeting

Full_Text: The Minister of Justice will expedite and supervise the issues in dispute between Harikesa Swami, Bhagavan das Goswami and Sundararupa Goswami on the one side and Bhaktiswarupa Damodar Goswami and Atreya Rsi prabhu on the other. Each side will select a mediator and the two mediators will select a third mediator.
Title: Mediation for Disputed Issues

Full_Text: This 3 man body will attempt to resolve the problem to the satisfaction of both parties. If not the matter will be referred to the GBC judicial committee.
Title: Mediation Body Scope

Full_Text: In every ISKCON Temple, Srila Prabhupada, as the founder acarya of ISKCON will have a Vyasasana which is substantially more prominent than any other vyasasana.
Title: Prominence of Srila Prabhupada Vyasasana

Full_Text: The photos of H.D.G. A.C.Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada: H.D,G. Bhaktisidanta Swami Prabhupada: Srila Gaura Kisora Das Babaj, Srila Bhaktivinode Thakura and Jaganatha das Babaji should always remain on all ISKCON altars.
Title: Parampara Photos on Altars

Full_Text: Local temple (or zonal) leaderships may determine the practical details of guru worship and protocol within the parameters authorised in the previous GBC resolutions. These include such things as: 1. Vyasasanas 2. Photographs 3. Altars etc.
Title: Local Authority on Guru Worship

Full_Text: The former "temple presidents meeting" will now be referred to as the " ISKCON Managers Meeting"
Title: ISKCON Managers Meeting Renaming

Full_Text: Those eligible to attend and vote in the "ISKCON Managers Meeting" are as follows: 1. The president of any authorized temple or preaching center listed in BTG or any official BBT publication. (Any center which cannot officially publish its address can get authorization from the GBC Chairman). 2. Regional secretaries 3. Global ministers 4. Zonal ministers 5. Headmaster of a major gurukula project. 6. The representative of a global minister who is a GBC minister.
Title: Managers Meeting Voting Eligibility

Full_Text: From hence forward the GBC meetings will be held after the annual festival at Sri Dham Mayapur.
Title: GBC Meeting Timing

Full_Text: Resolution regarding the GBC Emergency Meeting of September, 1985. Although the September 1985 Emergency Meeting was found to be improperly called and held according to GBC rules and proceedures, the GBC has recognized the concern of the assembled devotees and the relevance and importance of the issues, and has therefore taken up each resolution of that meeting as a proposal during this current General GBC Meeting.
Title: Revisiting Sept 1985 Proposals

Full_Text: The GBC body will approve goals and objections for its final secretaries and Ministers to be accomplished during the upcoming year.
Title: Approval of Ministerial Goals

Full_Text: The GBC executive committee request periodic report from its ministers.
Title: Ministerial Reports Requirement

Full_Text: The executive committee will mediate between GBC ministers and final secretaries if there is any conflict of interest in executing GBC directions.
Title: Conflict Mediation

Full_Text: Matters of no confidence regarding presidents, regional secretaries, or GBC zonal secretaries should be resolved locally failing which they will be referred to the appropriate judicial committee
Title: Resolving No Confidence Matters

Full_Text: That Rabindra Swarupa's paper ON MY ORDER' is not the official statement of the GBC body.
Title: On My Order Paper Status

Full_Text: The GBC affirms the principle of Zonal divisions and that the local zonal secretary is responsible for the overall management and administration of his zone AND IS ULTIMATELY RESPONSIBLE TO THE GBC BODY AS A WHOLE.
Title: Zonal Responsibility Principle

Full_Text: In case the GBC officers or a GBC subcommittee considers it necessary to convene an EXTRA ORDINARY MEETING the following the following proceders must be observed: 1. The reasons for the meeting as well as relevant background information should be specified in writing... 2. Sufficient time for exchanging correspondense must be allowed... 3. The ultimate decision to convene an EXTRA ODINARY MEETING, must be taken by the entire body... The decision is to be taken by a majority vote.
Title: Extraordinary Meeting Procedure

Full_Text: The Miniter Of Architecture should inspect ISKCON properties all around the world. If he finds that signifigent changes or corrections are required, he must give written notification to the local management... If the local GBC and temple authorties fail to comply the minister of architecture must notify the GBC executive committee and ultimately the GBC body for action.
Title: Minister of Architecture Inspection

Full_Text: The minister of architecture shall be consulted and given direction regarding all matters of maintenence, structure and aesthetics in any project constructed with International funds. No change in the maintence, structure or design can be done without his written permission.
Title: Minister of Architecture Permission

Full_Text: Faith in the Governing Body Commision as the ultimate managing authoritiy in ISKCON, shall be preserved, protected and enchanced by all ISKCON members. The authorized forum for GBC policy is the annual GBC meeting... Outside of these meetings it is the duty of all ISKCON members and leaders to support and adjust to GBC decisions... Activities contrary to this, shall be considered as a serious breach of etiquette and discipline.
Title: GBC Ultimate Authority Protection

Full_Text: Every GBC member must attend the annual GBC meeting for its entire duration. Any GBC member arriving late and/or leaving before the conclusion of the annual meeting, without prior consent of the executive committee, shall have his voting rites suspended for a period equal to the time missed.
Title: Annual Meeting Attendance Policy

Full_Text: Resolution: That the 30 acres of land purchased in Jagannatha Puri being held in the name of the father of Purnima Chand be transferred to ISKCON, (INDIA). H.D.G. Srila Bhakti Swarupa Damodara Goswami Maharaja shall thereupon be added as a land trustee... Purnima Chand dasa is directed to have this transfer performed as soon as possible.
Title: Jagannatha Puri Land Transfer

Full_Text: Properties may only be registered and/or held in the name of ministry with prior consent of the GBC body.
Title: Property Registration Consent

Full_Text: To provide the worldwide ISKCON community the means to resolve controversies... Compilation of a uniform world-wide code... Establishment and Organization of a world-wide system... Drawing up standardized judicial procedures... Establishment of a Ministry of Justice Central Office...
Title: Ministry of Justice Goals 1986

Full_Text: N B The GBC Body specifically empowered the Minister of Justice to initiate investigations without first having received a complaint and to issue injunctions.
Title: Justice Minister Special Powers

Full_Text: For all international projects (i.e. built with international funds) there shall be a board of directors of not less than five or more than seven of which the local GBC shall act as the Managing Director. The board of directors shall establish goals and strategies which they will be respnsible to follow up on.
Title: International Project Boards

Full_Text: Bhavananda Goswami will be the ISKCON Minister of Cultural Affairs. He will build a Cultural Center in Manhattan.
Title: Minister of Cultural Affairs Appointment

Full_Text: Notices to convene an Annual General Meeting at Sri Mayapur shall state the time... and it shall be sent by mail... not less than 120 days before... Proposals on any topic must be submitted... not less than 90 days before... final agenda... not less than 30 days before...
Title: GBC Annual Meeting Notice Procedures

Full_Text: All GBC secretaries... encourage and facilitate the establishment of " The Committee to free the Soviet Hare Krishnas"... Activities of the committee's branches will be co-ordinated by Kirtiraj das.
Title: Soviet Hare Krishnas Support

Full_Text: That Bhagavan Das Goswami will be the Minister of Book Distribution.
Title: Minister of Book Distribution Appointment

Full_Text: The BBT will publish a book (suitable for general distribution) which will philosophically establish the unique position of H.D.G. A.C. Bhaktivedanta Swami Prabhupada.
Title: Unique Position of Srila Prabhupada Book

Full_Text: Approved goals for the Ministry of Book Distribution are as follows; a. Develop set distribution... b. Assume responsibility for Sankirtan Newsletter... d. Publish a training guide... e. Bring temples up to 25% minimum remittance... h. Establish distribution as major basis for financial stability.
Title: Book Distribution Ministry Goals

Full_Text: Acknowledging with great appreciation and gratitude the accomplishment of Hayagriva das... we propose that any and all of Srila Prabhupada's books published must be done in the name of the BBT and must be copywrited by the BBT and the BBT only.
Title: BBT Copyright and Name Mandate

Full_Text: B.S. Damodara Swami will consult with Garuda das and Rabindra Swarupa concerning the use of the name "Bhaktivedanta Institute". He will report the discussion to the executive committee.
Title: Bhaktivedanta Institute Name Consultation

Full_Text: 13. B SDM will publish the proceedings of the Bombay Conference... 14. B SD M will publish a science magazine... 15. B SD M will conduct a B I conference in the Bay area... 16. B SD M will continue his book series... 17. B SD M will establish an institute for training graduate students at Tirupati for missionary work.
Title: B.S. Damodar Goswami BI Tasks

Full_Text: The B I will establish centers only after obtaining permission of the local GBC zonal secretaries.
Title: BI Center Establishment Rule

Full_Text: 22. Educational programs, beyond the primary level (ages 13 and above) shall be organised in a way which corresponds to the movement's stratagies... 23. In addition to the Ministry of Education, each one shall develop its own Ministry or Board of Education to conceive of and organise secondary and above educational programs...
Title: Zonal Boards of Education

Full_Text: The GBC directs the officers and managers of all ISKCON corporations to make all necessary and prudent arrangements to defend the corporations and their properties from legal liability, including lawsuits such as Robin George v. ISKCON etc. Failing to make such arrangements shall be sufficient ground for removal of the officers regional secretaries or GBC zonal secretaries.
Title: Legal Defense from Liability

Full_Text: If the establishment of a project within a particular zone will cause that zone or the temples within that zone to stop or greatly diminish their BBT remittence (ie,the GBC mandate of 25-50%) the GBC Zonal secretary must receive approval before the GBC body at the annual Mayapur meeting.
Title: BBT Remittance and Projects

Full_Text: In reference to the "Robin George Case," 1. Canada must pay by October 1986 a total of $50,000 (Canadian) in equal monthly installments. This to be divided amongst the Canadian temples as follows: Vancouver 40% Toronto 25% Motreal 25% Ottowa 10% If any temple fails to make their payment the local presidents will be asked to resign.
Title: Robin George Case Canada Payments

Full_Text: N.Y. must pay a total of $50,000 U.S. by October 1986. The desicion of payments is to be worked out by the responsible temples of the GBC general secretaries. These temples will have 6 months to meet their payments, failure to do so the local temple president will be asked to resign.
Title: Robin George Case NY Payments

Full_Text: For the time being, due to the Hawaii farm project, the Hawaii temple is exempt from the BBT remittence full of 25% 50%.
Title: Hawaii BBT Exemption

Full_Text: The GBC approves the following goals for the ISKCON Ministry of finance: a) To estaliblish communications with all Zonal ministers... b) To recruit staff... c) To recruit assistance to provide: business consultancy, real estate advisory... e) To collect annual financial statements from each of the zone.
Title: Ministry of Finance Goals

Full_Text: Based upon the GBC guidelines for initiating gurus, any GBC can present a diksa guru candidate before the GBC body. Unless the majority of voting members objects to the nomination, the candidate will be placed on a required one year waiting period, during which he should neither conclude or convey to others that he will automatically be approved.
Title: Guru Nomination Procedure

Full_Text: At the end of the yearly waiting period, the GBC body will review the candidates qualification taking account the opinion of the local leadership, and upon majority approval of the body, he may take up the responsibilities ofan initiating guru in ISKCON.
Title: Guru Candidate Review Process

Full_Text: The GBC gives its blessings to those who have begun to give formal initiations since September, 1985. They are as follows: 1. Lokanath Swmi - Padayatra, Pandarpura Delhi 2. Bhakti Abahya Carana Swami - Costa Rica, Guatamali 3. Maharam das Adhikary - Columbia 4. Bir Krsna Swami - North Carolina 5. Virabahu das Adhikari - Los Angeles Venezuela 6. Paramananda das Adhikar - Gita Nagari 7. Caru das Adhikari - Los Angeles, Utah 8. Narahari Swami - Hawaii 9. Radha Krsna Swami - Mexico
Title: Blessings for Recent Initiators

Full_Text: The following, who have received recommendation from 3 GBC members according to the September, 1985 GBC resolutions are given blessings to initiate. 1. Mahanidi Swami - Baltimore 2. Ramapada Swami - New York 3. Niranjana Swami - Boston 4. Navayogendra Swami - Punjab, Kenya, Kashmira, Gulf States 5. Rupanuga prabhu - Southern USA 6. Ravindra Swarupa prabhu - Mid Atlantic States
Title: New Initiating Gurus Approved

Full_Text: Vipramukhya Swami is placed on a one year waiting period, to be considered for initiation at the following Mayapur Festival.
Title: Vipramukhya Swami Waiting Period

Full_Text: That all of Bhavananda Goswamis GBC and initiations responsibilities can be resumed by him as of October, 1986.
Title: Bhavananda Goswami Responsibilities

Full_Text: Atreya Rsi prabhu is given blessings and authoriisation to take up initiating guru responsibilities. Mukunda Goswami is given blessings and authorisation to take up initiating guru responsibilities.
Title: Atreya Rsi and Mukunda Goswami Gurus

Full_Text: Ganapati Swami is given GBC blessings to begin initiation.
Title: Ganapati Swami Initiation Approval

Full_Text: Oaths for devotees approved to act as intiating spiritual masters, shall be administered in an ISKCON temple by the local GBC secretary as soon as possible after Governing Body Commision blessings have been given... The following procedure is recemmended for the ceremony: A. Public ceremony is held in temple room before Srila Prabhupada murti. B. Brief explenation is given to assembled devotees. C. Oath is read out by GBC Zonal Secretary and accepted by newly approved initiating guru. D. A garlend is taken from Srila Prabhupada and placed on devotee taking oath.
Title: Guru Oath Ceremony Procedure

Full_Text: The GBC blessings for becoming an initiating spiritual master on behalf of the disciplic succesion are given to devotees who have, for all practical purposes, fulfilled the qualifications and guidlines approved in this regard. GBC blessings are not intended to be a statement on the degree or leval of god realization of the initiating guru. Sadhu, Sastra and Guru are the authorized references... Candidates for initiation are personally responsible to accept initiation only after mature faith in the spiritual master has developed.
Title: Definition of GBC Guru Blessings

Full_Text: Bhaktiprabhava Maharaj is given blessings to take up the responsibilities of initiating guru.
Title: Bhaktiprabhava Maharaj Initiator

Full_Text: 19.The GBC body approves of the following devotees to immediately take up the responsibility of initiating spiritiiul master a.Vipramukhya Swami. The GBC approves of the following devotees to begin the responsibility of initiating spiritual master after 1 year period... a. Kavichandra Swami b. Jagad Guru Swami c. Prahaladananda Swami d. Trivrikram Swami e. Jayadwaita Swami f. Bhakticaru Swami
Title: New Initiating Gurus 1986-87

Full_Text: A 2/3 majority of voting members present will be required for 1. Removing a GBC.
Title: 2/3 Majority for GBC Removal

Full_Text: A 2/3 majority of voting members present will be required for 2. Removing a guru.
Title: 2/3 Majority for Guru Removal

Full_Text: A 2/3 majority of voting members present will be required for 3. Amending laws of ISKCON and standing orders of the GBC.
Title: 2/3 Majority to Amend Laws

Full_Text: A 2/3 majority of voting members present will be required for 4. Adding new GBC members.
Title: 2/3 Majority for New GBCs

Full_Text: All other proposals will require a simple majority of voting members present.
Title: Simple Majority for Other Proposals

Full_Text: That a simple majority (51%) will be required to change existing ISKCON laws and a 2/3 majority to change standing orders.
Title: Voting Requirements for Law Changes

Full_Text: Srila Prabhupada has instructed that it is exteremely important that all GBC meetings especially Emergency Meetings, be called and conducted according to proper procedure. The irregularities of the September, 1985, meeting were as follows: 1. Emergency meetings are to enforce and clarify existing GBC rules, not to change them or to create new laws. 2. Adequate notice was not given to all GBC members. 3. As per GBC rules, "stipulated topics" or agenda must be circulated before hand. 4. No minute book was maintained and specific resolutions were not recorded.
Title: Emergency Meeting Irregularities

Full_Text: No GBC member should publicly take the side of a non GBC member against another GBC.
Title: Public GBC Solidarity

Full_Text: No GBC member should enter into the Zone of another GBC member on the plea of protecting or helping someone within that zone, without the approval of local GBC.
Title: Zone Entry Restrictions

Full_Text: Every GBC member should support the decisions of the GBC body. He is free to express his opinion after first clearly presenting the will of GBC body.
Title: Support of GBC Decisions

Full_Text: A GBC member should never give ideas to non GBC members how to disrupt the decions or workings of the GBC body.
Title: Protecting GBC Decions

Full_Text: No sannyas initiation will be recognized unless the GBC proceedures have been followed.
Title: Sannyas Initiation Recognition

Full_Text: Mukunda Maharaja will be GBC for the Hawaii farm project and GBC with Ramesvara Swami for the rest of the yatra. The Hawaii temple will give a fixed committment of $8,500 a month for the first year after which a $500 per month, per year reduation, will go on until the monthly support is finished.
Title: Hawaii Projects Oversight

Full_Text: Zonal Assignments. All zones the same as 1985 except for the following modifications: 1. Rupanuga - GBC - Alaska 2. Prabhavisnu Swami - GBC - Brunei, Vietnam... Co. GBC with Jayapataka Swami- Malaysia... 3. Harikesa Swami - Co. GBC Hydrabad farm... 4. Bhagavandas Goswami - Cyprus, Malta. 5. Jayapataka Swami... No longer GBC of Brunia... 6. Mukunda Swami - Co. GBC Hawaii... 7. Bhavananda Goswami - Papua New Guinea. 8. Sudararupa Goswami - France 9. Jagadisha Goswami - Co. GBC with Gopal Krsna Canada, Seattle... 10. Atreya - Risikesa, Hardwar... 11. Gopal Krsna Goswami - Kuruksetra.
Title: Zonal Assignment Modifications

Full_Text: The Constitutional Committee shall consist of: a. Bhagavan Goswami b. Jayapataka Swami c. Balavanta das d. Harikesh Swami e. Mukunda Goswami f. 5 non-GBC representatives from the five continents selected by the presidents from the respective continents.
Title: Constitutional Committee Membership

Full_Text: The Retiring Chairman of the GBC will serve as a non-voting member of the GBC officers Committee for 1 more year.
Title: Retiring Chairman Committee Service

Full_Text: Adi Kesava Prabhu is no longer a member of the GBC Body. The GBC encourages him to continue his valuable service to the BBT, and to Back To Godhead Magazine.
Title: Removal of Adi Kesava Prabhu

Full_Text: Mukunda Goswami will be a full GBC member with full voting rights on the GBC body.
Title: Mukunda Goswami Full GBC

Full_Text: Ministers who are not GBC members will be known as Global Ministers, continental ministers, National or Regional Ministers.
Title: Ministerial Title Standardization

Full_Text: The 1986 GBC meeting will be held in Mayapur after Gaura Purnima Quintencennial Festival.
Title: 1986 GBC Meeting Date

Full_Text: The New Vrindavan Krsna Theme Park project is approved as the next official international fate project.
Title: New Vrindavan Theme Park Approval

Full_Text: This coming year the North American GBC will hold 3 istaghostis with their senior leaders to plan continental peaching strategies. Simultaneously, the North American zones will adopt and try to impliment the zonal assembly structure.
Title: North American Preaching Strategy

Full_Text: The 1986 Vrindavan Festival will be held for 4 days, just before the Mayapur Festival.
Title: 1986 Vrindavan Festival Duration

Full_Text: Each GBC proposal submitted to the Global Secretariat contain an explanation. If possible, the GBC man who submits the proposal should discuss it with the Global Secretariat before their meeting.
Title: GBC Proposal Explanations

Full_Text: Istaghostis of the full GBC Bocy and invited senior devotees are an official part of the GBC meetings.
Title: Official GBC Istaghostis

Full_Text: The Global Secretariat should continue to be appointed by the individual GBC members.
Title: Global Secretariat Appointment

Full_Text: A medical review board should be created by the GBC Body to deal with special cases of devotees having extreme health problems who have no temple willing to support them.
Title: Medical Review Board Establishment

Full_Text: The IFR is officialy part of the ministry of public affairs.
Title: IFR Ministry Affiliation

Full_Text: This coming year there will be daily readings from the Sri Caitanya Caritamrita in each temple.
Title: Caitanya Caritamrita Daily Reading

Full_Text: The Christmas Marathon will be officially titled the "Srila Prabhupada Marathon."

If the candidate wants to later change his area, his initiating functions shall again be reviewed and considered by the GBC Body under the conditions set down in the previous resolution. This establishes the GBC Body in in its position as the ultimate managing authority of Iskcon.

Full_Text: The GBC Resolutions must try to finalise the constitution before Lord Caitanya 500th Anniversary.The constitution will be finalised by going through the following stages: a. The GBC Constitutional Committee should delineate the basic principles and the GBC and expanded body of devotees should discuss b. A preliminary draft should be created according to the above principles and presented to the GBC and invites. The draft will also be presented to the temple presidents, sannyasis. Those disagreeing with specific points should do so in writing. c. The GBC constitutional committee should then examine the various suggestions. d. A revised draft should then be presented to the GBC members and different groups. e. The validity of the revisions should be determined and a final version drafted.
Title: Constitution Finalization Stages

The Global departmental committees will receive proposals from the GBC body as will as initiate proposals themselves.

Full_Text: Procedure. Each member of the GBC will submit the yearly proposals to the GBC officers committee (via.the secretary) who will assign proposals as follows: 1. Those to be exclusively dely with by the GBC (ie., new members, zones, privilege) 2. Those of a local nature and need not come before the GBC. 3. Those to be considered by the Global Departmental Committees All proposals are to be of a global nature as distinguished from local matters. The GBC secretary will present all proposals to be considered by the global departmental committees to the officers of the global secretariat who will meet with the chairmen of the global departmental committees and distribute proposals. After each global departmental committee has considered their respective proposals each chairman will present his proposals before the global secretariat which will approve modify or reject them. All proposals will then be presented before the GBC body for FINAL APPROVAL.
Title: GBC Proposal Handling Procedure

Full_Text: The global secretariat can also serve as a standards committee which can deal with any controversies that the GBC may assign to it.

Full_Text: [Amemndment to existing resolution on extending initiating Gurus] Initiating Gurus In ISKCON- That all GBC are candidates to become initiating Gurus with the requirements that they receive the blessings of 3/4 of all members of the GBC present, or 2/3 of the total GBC (whichever is greater) to begin their initiating role. The procedure for receiving the blessings shall be exclusively followed during the GBC annual meeting, and at no other time.
